app.title: ManSanket
app.tagline: Understand the emotions expressed through words.
app.subtitle: Discover the emotional tone behind everyday text in English, Hindi, and Marathi.
app.topic: Academic Topic 10: Emotion Detection from Text

home.welcome_lead: ManSanket helps you discover the emotional tone behind messages, reviews, social posts, and written thoughts. Whether your text is in English, Hindi, or Marathi, simply enter a sentence to see which emotion is most likely expressed.
home.emotions_subtitle: Built on the widely recognized 6-class CARER emotional taxonomy:
home.disclaimer_title: A Gentle Note on How This Works
home.disclaimer_body: ManSanket provides an automated estimate based on patterns in written text. Language is nuanced and deeply personal; this tool is designed to assist exploration and understanding, not to make definitive psychological judgments of someone's feelings.
home.academic_prompt: Looking for model evaluation matrices, dataset exploration, mathematical formulas, and viva questions?
home.academic_link: Explore the Academic Details section in the sidebar.

common.input_placeholder: Type or paste a sentence here (e.g., 'I am so excited to see you today!', 'आज निकाल लागला आणि खूप आनंद झाला', 'Bohot khush hu aaj')...
common.no_input_warn: Please enter a sentence before analyzing.
common.disclaimer_body: Highlighted words reflect statistical weights in the model's vocabulary. They do not constitute clinical or psychological assessments.

emotion_descriptions.joy: Conveys happiness, delight, celebration, excitement, or satisfaction.
emotion_descriptions.sadness: Conveys sorrow, grief, disappointment, heartbreak, or feeling low.
emotion_descriptions.love: Conveys warmth, affection, romantic care, fondness, or gratitude.
emotion_descriptions.anger: Conveys frustration, annoyance, irritation, outrage, or resentment.
emotion_descriptions.fear: Conveys anxiety, worry, panic, nervousness, or vulnerability.
emotion_descriptions.surprise: Conveys astonishment, wonder, shock, or an unexpected reaction.

analyzer.subtitle: Discover the emotional expression in your sentence.
analyzer.influential_words_intro: Words in your sentence that influenced this result most:

evaluation.subtitle: Rigorous experimental comparison of traditional NLP algorithms across identical test benchmarks.
evaluation.benchmark_summary: English CARER Emotion Test Set (2,000 samples across 6 emotion classes)
evaluation.metrics_explained: Metric Definitions: Precision reflects false positive resistance, Recall measures class sensitivity, and F1-score balances both across skewed distributions.

explainability.title: Model Interpretability & Feature Attribution
explainability.subtitle: Unpack how linear TF-IDF classifiers weigh vocabulary features across emotion categories.
explainability.how_it_works_desc: In linear models (Logistic Regression, Linear SVC), each vocabulary token has a learned weight matrix W for each class c. The contribution of token i to emotion c is the product of its TF-IDF value and weight W[c, i].
